# Global Venturers

> Premium small group tours of Morocco and beyond (eight travellers at most), with boutique riads, premium desert camps and beautiful, less-visited places. Led by explorer, photographer and filmmaker Bijan Paul, who has travelled to 115 countries and has run more than 200 private tours in Morocco through his company Moroccan Ventures. Based in Richmond upon Thames, London, UK.

Global Venturers is a trading name of Creative Capsule Ltd (company no. 08023109, registered in England & Wales). Contact: contact@globalventurers.com · WhatsApp/phone +44 7935 187068.

## Who it is for
Travellers, mostly aged 30 to 65, who value comfort, beautiful places to stay, a relaxed pace and avoiding the usual tourist roads. Couples, friends and solo travellers (private rooms available).

## Current journey: Morocco Signature Journey
- Dates: Sunday 10 – Thursday 21 October 2027 (12 days), starting and ending in Marrakech
- Group size: maximum 8 travellers; runs with a minimum of 6
- Price: £3,200 per person in a shared twin/double room; private room +£650 (£3,850). 30% deposit to book; balance due 60 days before departure
- Included: boutique hotels and riads, premium desert camps, tour leader throughout, local guides, private air-conditioned vehicles for the group (no trains, no coaches) and listed activities
- Style: off the beaten track, Morocco's hidden gems (Erg Chegaga, Agdz and the Draa Valley, Tetouan, Asilah, Jebel Saghro back roads, Middle Atlas cedar forests), avoiding the busiest tourist circuits; a small group that ends the journey as friends
- Not included: food and drinks, flights, travel insurance (required)
- Route: Marrakech (2 nights), Agdz (1), Erg Chegaga via M'Hamid (2), Merzouga (1), Fes (1), Chefchaouen (1), Tetouan (1), Tangier (1), Casablanca via Asilah (1), private transfer back to Marrakech
- Page and booking: https://globalventurers.com/morocco/

## Itinerary
- Day 1, Marrakech: Arrival in Marrakech. Settle into your boutique riad in the medina and meet your tour leader over mint tea in the courtyard. In the evening, a welcome dinner on a rooftop terrace as the city lights up. Overnight: Boutique riad, Marrakech.
- Day 2, Marrakech: Gardens, palaces and souks. An unhurried private tour of Jardin Majorelle and the Bahia Palace, then the souks with a local expert. Afternoon at leisure, with a traditional hammam ritual and time by the riad pool. Overnight: Boutique riad, Marrakech.
- Day 3, Marrakech to Agdz: Over the High Atlas. A scenic drive over the High Atlas by the Tizi n'Tichka pass, with time to wander the ksar of Aït Ben Haddou. Then on past Ouarzazate into the Draa Valley to Agdz, a quiet oasis town of palm groves and old kasbahs. Overnight: Kasbah guesthouse, Agdz.
- Day 4, Agdz to Erg Chegaga: Into the deep Sahara. Follow the Draa Valley south through Zagora to M’Hamid, the last village before the desert. From here we leave the road by 4x4 for Erg Chegaga, Morocco’s wildest dunes, arriving at camp in time for sunset. Overnight: Premium desert camp, Erg Chegaga.
- Day 5, Erg Chegaga: A day in the dunes. Sunrise from the highest dunes, a slow day at camp and an evening of music around the fire under a sky full of stars. Far from the crowds, this is the Sahara at its most peaceful. Overnight: Premium desert camp, Erg Chegaga.
- Day 6, Erg Chegaga to Merzouga: From one sea of dunes to another. Back to M’Hamid by 4x4, then east on quiet desert roads through Tazzarine and Alnif, past the foot of the Jebel Saghro, to the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi at Merzouga, arriving in time for sunset over the dunes. A long day through landscapes few travellers ever see. Overnight: Premium desert camp with en-suite tents, Merzouga.
- Day 7, Merzouga to Fes: North through the Middle Atlas. Up the palm-lined Ziz Valley and the Ziz Gorges, then across the Middle Atlas via Midelt and the cedar forests around Ifrane, with relaxed stops along the way. Arrive in Fes in time for an evening walk in the medina. Overnight: Elegant riad, Fes.
- Day 8, Fes to Chefchaouen: The medina of Fes, then the blue town. A morning in Fes el-Bali with a historian guide: the Chouara tannery, Al Quaraouiyine and the artisans' quarters. In the afternoon, a drive into the Rif Mountains to Chefchaouen for sunset from the Spanish Mosque. Overnight: Boutique riad, Chefchaouen.
- Day 9, Chefchaouen to Tetouan: The white dove. A slow morning in the blue lanes of Chefchaouen, then a short drive to Tetouan, whose UNESCO-listed medina, shaped by Andalusian refugees, is one of the best preserved and least visited in Morocco. Overnight: Traditional riad, Tetouan.
- Day 10, Tetouan to Tangier: To the Strait of Gibraltar. A short drive to Tangier and Cap Spartel, where the Atlantic meets the Mediterranean. Wander the kasbah and end the day with mint tea at Café Hafa as the sun sets over the Strait of Gibraltar. Overnight: Boutique hotel, Tangier.
- Day 11, Tangier to Casablanca: Down the Atlantic coast. A comfortable drive south along the Atlantic coast, with a stop in Asilah, a whitewashed seaside town of murals and ramparts. In Casablanca, visit the Hassan II Mosque, standing right on the Atlantic, and spend a last evening together by the ocean. Overnight: Boutique hotel, Casablanca.
- Day 12, Casablanca to Marrakech: Departure. A leisurely breakfast, then a private transfer back to Marrakech, about three hours away, in time for flights home.

## FAQ
- **Who organises Global Venturers journeys?** Global Venturers was founded by Bijan Paul and runs premium group tours alongside Moroccan Ventures, our Morocco tour company. Every group tour is planned by us and led in person by an experienced tour leader. Global Venturers is a trading name of Creative Capsule Ltd, registered in England & Wales (company number 08023109), with its registered office at 8 Sycamore House, Richmond upon Thames, London TW11 9PE.
- **How does booking work?** Choose a departure, complete the short booking form and pay a 30% deposit to secure your place. The deposit is refundable within 14 days of booking, and the balance is due 60 days before departure.
- **What is included in the price?** Accommodation, a tour leader for the whole journey, local guides, private transport and the activities listed on each journey page. Food and drinks are not included, so you’re free to eat where and what you like, and your tour leader will always point you to great places nearby. International flights and travel insurance are also not included.
- **Can I travel solo?** Absolutely, many of our travellers do. You can book a private room for a single supplement, or ask to share with another solo traveller of the same gender.
- **Is this an off-the-beaten-track Morocco tour?** Yes. Alongside highlights like Fes and Chefchaouen, the route takes in Erg Chegaga, the Draa Valley, Tetouan and Asilah, places most group tours skip, and avoids the busiest coach-tour stops wherever we can.
- **How do I book?** Tap Book your place, add your details and pay a 30% deposit securely with Stripe to confirm your place. Stripe is one of the world’s most trusted payment platforms: your card details are encrypted and never shared with us. If you prefer, you can request a payment link by email instead. The deposit is refundable within 14 days of booking, and the balance is due 60 days before departure, or you can pay in full when you book.
- **I'm travelling solo. Do I have to share?** No. Choose a private room for a single supplement, or ask to share with another solo guest of the same gender.
- **Who is this journey for?** Travellers who appreciate comfort, beautiful places to stay and a relaxed pace, mostly aged 30 to 65. You’ll need a reasonable level of fitness for medina walks, and there are a few longer scenic drives with comfortable stops along the way.
- **Are flights included?** No, so you can fly from wherever suits you. The journey starts and ends in Marrakech, so a simple return flight works: arrive on 10 October and fly home on 21 October. Airport transfers on those dates are included.
- **What if the group doesn't fill?** The journey runs with a minimum of six guests. If we ever have to cancel, we’ll tell you at least 60 days before departure and refund everything you've paid.
- **Can I add nights before or after?** Yes. We can arrange extra nights in Marrakech before or after the journey, or a short extension to Essaouira.
